pijat-tradisional.title: Traditional Massage
pijat-tradisional.description: Traditional Massage at Paradise Massage offers a relaxing experience designed to help the body feel more relaxed and comfortable after various daily activities. The massage techniques use gentle strokes and adjusted pressure on several areas of the body, providing a soothing sensation and helping to release tension after daily activities. This treatment is suitable for those who want to take some time to rest and enjoy a calming massage experience.

2.title: Helps Reduce Feelings of Fatigue
2.description: This treatment can be a suitable choice for taking a short break after a busy day and helping the body feel refreshed after the treatment.

refleksi.title: Reflexology
refleksi.description: Reflexology at Paradise Massage uses pressure techniques on specific points on the soles of the feet to provide a comfortable and relaxing experience. This treatment is suitable for those who spend a lot of time standing, walking, or using their feet throughout the day. With adjusted pressure, the feet can feel lighter while giving the body an opportunity to rest more comfortably.

totok-wajah.title: Face Acupressure
totok-wajah.description: Face Acupressure at Paradise Massage is a facial treatment that uses gentle pressure techniques on specific points around the face. This treatment is designed to provide a relaxing sensation for the face after daily activities. Slow and gentle movements and pressure create a comfortable treatment experience, helping the face feel more relaxed and refreshed.

pijat-pelepas-lelah.title: Scraping Massage
pijat-pelepas-lelah.description: Scraping Massage uses a traditional scraping technique, known as kerokan, performed in a controlled manner to provide a relaxing experience after daily activities. The treatment is performed on specific areas of the body using adjusted movements to create a warm and comfortable sensation. It is suitable for those who want to enjoy a traditional treatment as part of their time for rest and relaxation.

pijat-kebugaran.title: Deep Tissue Massage
pijat-kebugaran.description: Deep Tissue Massage uses massage techniques with deeper pressure on specific muscle areas. This treatment is intended to provide a relaxing experience after physical activity or a busy daily routine. The massage pressure can be adjusted according to your comfort, helping the body feel more relaxed and comfortable after the treatment.

pijat-titik-relaksasi.title: Relaxation Point Massage
pijat-titik-relaksasi.description: Relaxation Point Massage uses pressure techniques on specific points of the body to provide a comfortable and relaxing experience. shiatsu.title: Shiatsu
shiatsu.description: Shiatsu is a traditional Japanese massage technique that uses finger and palm pressure on specific points of the body. The pressure is applied consistently and adjusted according to your comfort to create a soothing massage experience. This treatment is suitable for those who want to enjoy a massage using traditional Japanese techniques while giving their body time to rest and relax.
